degradations.name: gaussian_noise
degradations.description: Additive zero-mean Gaussian sensor noise. Every pixel is wrong by a small amount.

degradations.name: salt_pepper
degradations.description: Impulse noise: 4% of pixels set to 0 or 255. A few pixels are catastrophically wrong; the rest are untouched.

degradations.name: defocus_blur
degradations.description: Gaussian defocus. High-frequency detail is destroyed rather than corrupted - this is why no smoothing filter recovers it.
